official: 寒川町認可地縁団体印鑑条例の一部改正について
session: 令和8年第1回定例会9月会議
name: 代理人の根拠条文の引用を変更
summary: 認可地縁団体は、代理人を置いている場合、印鑑登録などの申請や届出を代理人に任せられます。この条例では、代理人について定める規則の条文番号を変更し、令和8年10月1日から施行します。
changes: 代理人を定める規則の引用先を変更する
why: 地方自治法施行規則の一部改正に伴い、条文を整理するためと、町は説明しています。

en.name: Changes the citation to the provision on representatives
en.official: Regarding the Partial Amendment to the Samukawa Town Ordinance on Seal Registration for Authorized Neighborhood Associations
en.summary: If an authorized neighborhood association has appointed a representative, it can have that representative handle applications and notifications, including those for seal registration. This ordinance changes the article number cited in the rules that set out the provisions on representatives and takes effect on October 1, 2026.
changes: Changes the reference to the provision in the rules that sets out representatives
en.why: The town says this is to reorganize the provisions following a partial amendment to the Enforcement Regulations of the Local Autonomy Act.
